description: This is a shell script file related to Git testing, specifically for testing multi_ack pack fetching and related Git fetch-pack operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified name and parents, updates refs, and prepares repository state for testing.

methods.name: pull_to_client
methods.description: Simulates fetching packs into a client repository, verifying pack counts and ref updates.

methods.name: check_prot_path
methods.description: Checks protocol diagnostics with URL, protocol, and path parameters.

methods.name: check_prot_host_port_path
methods.description: Checks protocol diagnostics with host, port, and path parameters, considering protocols like SSH or file.

methods.name: fetch_filter_blob_limit_zero
methods.description: Tests fetching with a blob size filter of zero, verifying behavior with server repository.
